SRD type: Demon

Demons are a race of creatures native to chaotic evil-aligned planes. They are ferocity personified and will attack any creature just for the sheer fun of it—even other demons.

Demon Traits

Most demons possess the following traits (unless otherwise noted in a creature’s entry).

  • Immunity to electricity and poison.
  • Resistance to acid 10, cold 10, and fire 10.
  • Summon (Sp): Many demons share the ability to summon others of their kind (the success chance and type of demon summoned are noted in each monster description). Demons are often reluctant to use this power until in obvious peril or extreme circumstances.
  • Telepathy.

Except where otherwise noted, demons speak Abyssal, Celestial, and Draconic.

Special Attacks: Improved grab, spell-like abilities, summon demon

Special Qualities: Damage reduction 10/good, darkvision 60 ft., immunity to electricity and poison, resistance to acid 10, cold 10, and fire 10, spell resistance 21, telepathy 100 ft., true seeing

Imported from the d20 SRD; verify attacks and skills in-game. Full rules at d20srd.org.

system.biography:
Like succubi, glabrezu tempt victims into ruin, but they lure their prey with power or wealth rather than passion.

Glabrezu have penetrating violet eyes, and their skin color ranges from deep russet to pitch black. A glabrezu stands about 15 feet tall and weighs about 5,500 pounds.

Combat

Glabrezu prefer subterfuge to combat. However, if their attempts to entice or deceive fail, these enormous demons attack with a vengeance. They follow a confusion attack with melee attacks, hoping to finish off wounded foes with chaos hammer or unholy blight.

A glabrezu’s natural weapons, as well as any weapons it wields, are treated as chaotic-aligned and evil-aligned for the purpose of overcoming damage reduction.

Improved Grab (Ex)

To use this ability, a glabrezu must hit a Medium or smaller opponent with a pincer attack. It can then attempt to start a grapple as a free action without provoking an attack of opportunity.

Spell-Like Abilities

At will—chaos hammer (DC 19), confusion (DC 19), dispel magic, mirror image, reverse gravity (DC 22), greater teleport (self plus 50 pounds of objects only), unholy blight (DC 19); 1/day—power word stun. Caster level 14th. The save DCs are Charisma-based.

Once per month, a glabrezu can fulfill a wish for a mortal humanoid. The demon can use this ability to offer a mortal whatever he or she desires—but unless the wish is used to create pain and suffering in the world, the glabrezu demands either terrible evil acts or great sacrifice as compensation.

Summon Demon (Sp)

Once per day a glabrezu can attempt to summon 4d10 dretches or 1d2 vrocks with a 50% chance of success, or another glabrezu with a 20% chance of success. This ability is the equivalent of a 4th-level spell.

True Seeing (Su)

Glabrezu continuously use true seeing as the spell (caster level 14th).

Skills

Glabrezu have a +8 racial bonus on Listen and Spot checks.

system.description: You can strike two adjacent foes with a single swing.
system.benefit: As a standard action, you can make a single attack at your full base attack bonus against a foe within reach. If you hit, you deal damage normally and can make an additional attack (using your full base attack bonus) against a foe that is adjacent to the first and also within reach. You can only make one additional attack per round with this feat. You cannot use this feat if you are wearing heavy armor.
system.special: A fighter may select Cleave as one of his fighter bonus feats.

system.description: You can strike many adjacent foes with a single swing.
system.prerequisites: Cleave, Power Attack, Str 13, base attack bonus +4
system.benefit: As a standard action, you can make a single attack at your full base attack bonus against a foe within reach. If you hit, you deal damage normally and can make an additional attack (using your full base attack bonus) against a foe that is adjacent to the first and also within reach. If you hit that foe, you can continue to make attacks against other adjacent foes so long as you keep hitting. You cannot attack an individual foe more than once per round with this feat. You cannot use this feat if you are wearing heavy armor.
system.special: A fighter may select Great Cleave as one of his fighter bonus feats.

system.description: You are skilled at swaying opinions and changing minds.
system.benefit: You get a +2 bonus on all Diplomacy checks and Intimidate checks.

system.description: You can make exceptionally powerful melee attacks.
system.benefit: On your action, before making attack rolls for a round, you may choose to subtract a number from all melee attack rolls and add the same number to all melee damage rolls. This number may not exceed your base attack bonus. The penalty on attacks and bonus on damage apply until your next turn.

system.description: You know how to tell a lie.
Make a Concentration check whenever you might be distracted (by taking damage, by harsh weather, and so on) while engaged in some action that requires your full attention.
You can use this skill to persuade others to agree with your arguments, to resolve differences, and to gather valuable information or rumors from people.
You are skilled at changing your appearance.
You can use this skill to frighten opponents or to get them to act in a way that benefits you.
Ancient mysteries, magic traditions, arcane symbols, cryptic phrases, constructs, dragons, magical beasts. Like other Knowledge skills, each Knowledge field is a separate skill with its own ranks.
Your Listen check is either made against a DC that reflects how quiet the noise is that you might hear, or it is opposed by the target's Move Silently check.
Make a Move Silently check when you try to sneak past enemies or move without being heard.
You can find secret doors, traps, and hidden objects.
You can get a hunch about a social situation or read a person.
You are skilled at working with magic and can identify spells as they are cast or spells already in place.
Your Spot check is either made against a DC that reflects how obvious the object is, or it is opposed by the target's Hide check.
You are skilled at surviving in the wild and at following tracks.

Spell-like abilities: Includes chaos hammer, confusion, dispel magic, mirror image, power word stun, true seeing at will, and unholy blight at listed frequencies; caster level per stat block.

Improved grab: Pincers may start grapple after hit.

Summon demon (Sp): Chance to summon another demon type per entry.

True seeing (Su): Continuous as listed.

What it does (SRD): The creature ignores the first N points of damage from each attack or effect of the listed energy type.

ThirdEra: Type and amount are set under CGS parameters and overrides (merged over an empty template grant list).

What it does (SRD): The creature is immune to poison: it does not take ability damage or hit point damage from poison, and it ignores other harmful poison effects unless a specific effect overrides immunity.

ThirdEra: On this item’s Details tab, poison immunity is under Capability grants (immunity), not as save or AC bonuses in Mechanical effects. The character sheet lists it with other immunities and defenses from the creature’s items and features.
